content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to request a few adjustments before signing:

- Regarding the relevant clause, the agreement permits unlimited revision rounds. I propose that if the deliverable fails to satisfy the criteria, the parties shall mutually agree in writing upon any additional correction rounds or the client may terminate the agreement.

- Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership transfers before full payment is made. I propose that ownership of the deliverables shall remain with the contractor until the client has paid all fees due under the agreement.

Best regards,
